content:
Maya Patel: quick heads-up — i'm about to land a tiny terraform change that adds a configmap for per-model feature flags. it's just the flags + a checksum annotation so pods can roll automatically.
Dan Kim: ping @maya — can you paste the planned k8s manifest snippet? want to make sure the mount path matches redwood-models config convention.
Maya Patel: sure, excerpt below. it's mounted at /etc/model-config and the checksum is on the deployment template: 
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: model-feature-flags
data:
  gpt4x_enabled: "true"
  embed_cache_ttl: "300"
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: model-server
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        config-checksum: "${checksum}"
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: server
        volumeMounts:
        - name: flags
          mountPath: /etc/model-config
      volumes:
      - name: flags
        configMap:
          name: model-feature-flags
```
Sanjay Rao: two quick q's — if we change a flag later do we rely on rolling update via checksum only, or do we also expect any runtime hot-reload?
Maya Patel: current model-server supports hot-reload for flags on SIGHUP but not for all keys. for safety we rely on checksum-triggered rolling update for anything that impacts batching/kvcache opts.
Jen Liu: FYI i'm about to open a PR that moves the tf resource to create the configmap from the new module. will include the checksum calculation using filebase64sha1.
Lia Gomez: any secret wiring concerns? i noticed some flags need to read an API key for a telemetry opt-out. secrets should not go into the configmap.
Maya Patel: good call — telemetry keys are in the existing secret redwood-model-secrets. i'll update the container to read that secret via envFrom and keep flags configmap-only.
Dan Kim: can someone from infra review the terraform PR? I can give a quick pass but would prefer @Sanjay or @Lia to check the secrets mapping + K8s RBAC bits.
Sanjay Rao: i'll review after stand. checklist: (1) tf change creates configmap + checksum output, (2) deployment annotation references that checksum, (3) no secrets copied into the cm, (4) rolebinding allows deployment to patch pods if needed.
Maya Patel: thanks. i'm also adding a small integration test in pipeline that applies the cm to a test namespace and validates the deployment rolled. will post PR link in 15.
ops-bot: deploy-bot noticed a pending change: terraform plan for infra/model-configs (user: maya) ready for review — link: https://ci.internal/plan/9842 :eyes:
Jen Liu: tagging @devex - can we add a short note in the runtime docs about where feature flags live and the rollback procedure? small blurb near "config management" would be ideal.
Lia Gomez: agree, also include steps for emergency flag flip (kubectl patch cm) and how to force a rolling restart if checksum not picked up.
Maya Patel: will add the docs and the PR. thanks all. once reviews are in i'll merge and ping this thread with the plan and time window. :thumbsup:
